property_summary: The transfer function must return true for all valid inputs; the mutant returns false, violating the invariant that its return value equals true.
For all inputs where the external calls succeed, the return value of transfer should equal the AND over all individual call successes; the mutant returns false regardless of call outcomes.
After completion, transfer must return true; the mutant always returns false, violating the invariant that the return value equals true.
For any input where all internal caddress.call() calls succeed without reverting, the transfer function must return true; the mutant incorrectly returns false.

For any admissible input, the return value of transfer must equal false if the call to caddress reverts, otherwise it must equal true; the mutant always returns false, so it differs when the call succeeds.
